method: Built-in image_gen: original character-free raster scenery and surface source sheets, followed by user-authorized non-generative source-preserving reconstruction. Revision3 style-transfer uses own source atlas and supplied reference for scenery style only; no reference pixel extraction, source atlas pixel rewrite or character authoring.
requested_dimensions_note: Requested 2048-square atlas and1024-square surface sheet; tool returned1254-square for each. Actual bounds measured and pinned, never assumed.
source_editability: Original source rasters plus named-object scene-layout.svg, ground-layout.svg pattern polygons, layout.json, build-painted.py and original native proposal compositions. Generated raster contents are not native vector layers.
alpha_note: Source atlas has genuine RGBA alpha; source pixels are retained unchanged. Runtime alpha composition is checked separately from RGB-only viewers.
authorship: AI-generated original scenery; no external stock/license or original character asset was sampled.
runtime_labels: Only original stage/sign typography is in sprite artwork. All six overview destination labels are runtime text.
